response.sql: WITH per_invoice AS (SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(l.product_price) AS mean_price, COUNT(l.order_item_id) AS n_items FROM Invoices i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items l ON l.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number) SELECT AVG(mean_price) AS avg_of_invoice_mean_price, AVG(n_items * 1.0) AS avg_line_items_per_invoice FROM per_invoice

assumptions.assumption: Each row in Invoice_Line_Items counts as one line item, regardless of product_quantity; COUNT(l.order_item_id) is 0 for invoices with no line items (order_item_id is NOT NULL).

Per-invoice mean is the unweighted mean of product_price over rows, ignoring NULLs; invoices with all-NULL or no prices yield NULL and are skipped by AVG in the first value, while still counting in the second.
